title: 2026 Pennsylvania gubernatorial election
description: Pennsylvania will elect its governor in 2026 for a four-year term. The governor oversees the state executive branch, proposes budgets, and sets priorities on taxes, education, energy, and abortion policy. The race is expected to be a major partisan contest in a closely watched swing state, with Democratic Gov. Josh Shapiro seeking re-election and Republican state Treasurer Stacy Garrity emerging as the leading GOP challenger. Early public polling has shown Shapiro ahead, but the general-election matchup remains a key test of each party’s standing in Pennsylvania.

candidates.name: Josh Shapiro
candidates.summary: Josh Shapiro is the 48th governor of Pennsylvania and is seeking re-election in 2026. Before becoming governor in 2023, he served as Pennsylvania attorney general from 2017 to 2023 and as Montgomery County commissioner from 2011 to 2017.

career_history.description: Serves as the chief executive of Pennsylvania.

candidates.donor_summary: Raised approximately $14.1M in 2026 Pennsylvania gubernatorial-cycle contributions, with the largest disclosed support coming from labor and professional sectors. OpenSecrets shows his donor base historically dominated by building trade unions, lawyers/law firms, and electronics manufacturing, while Pennsylvania campaign finance filings show he entered 2026 with about $30.2M cash on hand and ended the latest reported period with about $37.8M cash on hand.

candidates.voting_summary: Josh Shapiro is a non-legislator in this race and has no legislative voting record to report. He has held executive office as Pennsylvania governor since 2023, so the closest governing record is his administration’s official actions and policy agenda rather than roll-call votes.

Healthcare.stance: Shapiro supports expanding access to affordable healthcare, including funding recovery services, lowering prescription drug costs, and requiring insurance coverage for preventive screenings and telemedicine. His administration says it has also increased support for rural hospitals, mental health services, and Medicaid access.

sources.title: Healthcare | Commonwealth of Pennsylvania
Governor Josh Shapiro | Commonwealth of Pennsylvania

Economy.stance: Shapiro says his budget and economic agenda are focused on lowering costs, cutting red tape, and attracting private investment. The governor’s office says his administration has created more than 21,500 jobs and attracted more than $39 billion in private-sector investment, while also proposing tax relief for working families and small businesses.

Climate/Energy.stance: Shapiro supports expanding clean energy and reducing energy costs through a Pennsylvania-specific climate approach, permitting reform, and investment in energy production. His administration has proposed new renewable energy goals and says it is pursuing an all-of-the-above strategy that includes clean energy, industry decarbonization, and grid reliability.

sources.title: Gov Shapiro 2026–27 Budget Proposal to Keep Doing What’s Working in Pennsylvania
Environmental Protection | Commonwealth of Pennsylvania

Abortion & Reproductive Health.stance: Shapiro supports abortion rights and says he will defend access to reproductive healthcare in Pennsylvania. As governor, he has taken actions to protect abortion access and has publicly opposed restrictions on abortion and related care.

sources.title: Gov. Shapiro Takes Action To Protect Abortion Access
Governor Josh Shapiro | Commonwealth of Pennsylvania

Immigration.stance: Shapiro has taken a generally pro-immigrant approach as governor, including issuing state guidance for people and organizations during immigration enforcement operations. He has also criticized federal immigration enforcement tactics and said Pennsylvania should be prepared for possible federal crackdowns.

sources.title: Know Your Rights | Commonwealth of Pennsylvania
Gov. Josh Shapiro: Pennsylvania ready if Trump immigration crackdown

Firearms & Second Amendment.stance: Shapiro says he supports the Second Amendment while backing gun-violence prevention measures. His administration has re-established the state Office of Gun Violence Prevention and proposed additional funding for violence intervention, police, and fire services.

sources.title: Office of Gun Violence Prevention - Commonwealth of Pennsylvania
Gov Shapiro 2026–27 Budget Proposal to Keep Doing What’s Working in Pennsylvania

Foreign Policy.stance: Shapiro has publicly emphasized support for Israel and for U.S.-Israel security cooperation, while also criticizing some actions of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. His comments on the issue have focused on the Israel-Gaza conflict and U.S. support for Israel.

sources.title: Shapiro leans into support for Israel on podcast tour - The Hill
As Democrats shift on Israel, Josh Shapiro stands firm - The Forward

Civil Rights & Equality.stance: Shapiro has said he supports nondiscrimination protections for LGBTQ+ Pennsylvanians and has repeatedly called for passage of the Fairness Act. The governor’s office says his administration is committed to protecting LGBTQ+ state employees and expanding equal protection under the law.

sources.title: ICYMI: 50 Years of Protection from Discrimination for LGBTQ+ State Employees
Governor Josh Shapiro | Commonwealth of Pennsylvania

Tech & AI.stance: Shapiro says Pennsylvania should use AI responsibly, with consumer protections and enforcement against deceptive uses. His administration has launched AI-related literacy and enforcement efforts and has framed the issue around protecting students and consumers.

sources.title: Governor Shapiro Takes Action to Protect Pennsylvanians Using AI
Shapiro admin using task force to crack down on misleading AI chatbots

Election Policy.stance: Shapiro says he supports secure and accessible voting and has defended Pennsylvania’s election system against federal overreach. His administration says it implemented automatic voter registration and has taken legal action to protect voting rights and election administration.

sources.title: Governor Josh Shapiro | Commonwealth of Pennsylvania
Governor Shapiro Takes Legal Action to Protect Pennsylvanians’ Right to Vote

Education.stance: Shapiro supports increased public education funding, career and technical education, early childhood programs, and higher education affordability. His administration says it has delivered historic K-12 funding increases, expanded free school breakfast, and increased support for teachers and student aid.

Local Issues.stance: Shapiro’s local-issues agenda emphasizes broadband expansion, rural health support, and managing data-center growth with community input. His administration has also highlighted support for small businesses, main streets, and local governments through targeted state investments.

candidates.name: Stacy Garrity
candidates.summary: Stacy Garrity is Pennsylvania’s state treasurer and the Republican nominee for governor in 2026. Her campaign emphasizes energy production, tax relief, property-tax rebates, and tighter state-government oversight.

candidates.donor_summary: Public disclosures show Garrity’s 2026 campaign had about $1.0M in new fundraising in the latest reported period, far behind Shapiro’s totals. Available public pages do not provide a clean OpenSecrets-style industry breakdown for her gubernatorial campaign, but Pennsylvania campaign finance filings and news coverage indicate a much smaller fundraising operation with roughly $28.6K in 2020 receipts on the state portal for the earlier Garrity committee record and a 2026 cash position that trails Shapiro by about 10-to-1.

Healthcare.stance: Garrity supports allowing the ACA premium tax credits to expire and has aligned herself with Republican arguments for market-based health care reforms. Her public comments have framed this approach as the correct path for addressing health-care costs.

sources.title: Heartland Signal: Garrity says GOP was correct to let health care tax credits expire
PA Dems: The GOP Healthcare Cuts Stacy Garrity Supports

Economy.stance: Garrity’s Turn Around PA plan calls for expanding energy production, cutting taxes, and using property-tax rebates to make life more affordable for Pennsylvania families. The campaign says these steps would support job growth, lower utility costs, and reduce the burden of government spending.

sources.title: Issues - Stacy Garrity for Governor

Climate/Energy.stance: Garrity supports lifting the ban on new drilling sites, speeding permits for natural gas, pipelines, and power plants, and rolling back or pausing some renewable-energy mandates. Her campaign says the goal is to increase supply, improve grid reliability, and lower electricity costs.

sources.title: Issues - Stacy Garrity for Governor

Abortion & Reproductive Health.stance: Garrity has aligned with anti-abortion and pro-life positions and has criticized efforts to expand abortion-related coverage. Public reporting describes her as opposing abortion-rights protections in Pennsylvania.

sources.title: Garrity derides Pennsylvania court's ruling on Medicaid coverage for abortion

Immigration.stance: Garrity has not laid out a detailed immigration platform, but she has said proposed ICE detention facilities in Pennsylvania warrant serious review rather than automatic opposition. Reporting on the race describes her position as cautious and not fully defined.

sources.title: How Garrity would approach ICE detention as PA governor – Spotlight PA

Firearms & Second Amendment.stance: Garrity presents herself as a strong Second Amendment supporter. Gun-rights groups have endorsed her and highlighted support for constitutional carry and stronger firearms preemption.

sources.title: GOA Endorses Stacy Garrity for Governor and Jason Richey for Lt Governor – GOA Pennsylvania

Civil Rights & Equality.stance: Garrity’s campaign supports voter ID and says every voter should be a U.S. citizen and show identification. It also backs a ban on transgender girls and women competing in girls’ sports, framing the policy as protecting fairness and safety.

sources.title: Issues - Stacy Garrity for Governor

Tech & AI.stance: Garrity has said rural Pennsylvania could host data centers to support AI growth and that local communities should be part of planning for that expansion. Reporting on the race says she sees data centers as a potential economic-development opportunity.

sources.title: Rural Pa could house data centers for AI growth, Garrity says - WITF
Garrity: Rural Pa. could house data centers for AI growth | 90.5 WESA

Election Policy.stance: Garrity supports voter ID and says elections should be easy for eligible voters but hard to cheat. Her campaign says every voter should be a U.S. citizen and show ID.

sources.title: Issues - Stacy Garrity for Governor
Garrity Calls On Shapiro To Secure Elections - Politics PA

Foreign Policy.stance: No public position found on foreign policy.

Education.stance: Garrity supports expanding school-choice programs, including Lifeline Scholarships, the Education Improvement Tax Credit, and the Opportunity Scholarship Tax Credit. Her campaign says these programs would help students leave failing schools and expand access to tutoring, literacy, and STEM opportunities.

sources.title: Issues - Stacy Garrity for Governor

Local Issues.stance: Garrity’s campaign highlights property-tax relief, homeownership support, and energy affordability as major local priorities. It says its HOPE for PA plan would reduce the property-tax burden and help first-time homebuyers.

reviews.summary: This is a well-researched and professionally presented profile of the 2026 Pennsylvania gubernatorial race. Both candidates are documented with consistent career histories, substantive issue positions tied to credible sources (official state websites, campaign sites, established news outlets, and finance databases), and balanced framing. The polling data is properly cited with sample sizes and source URLs. Sourcing across the 12 issue areas is comprehensive and current (May 2026), with high-confidence designations reflecting official positions and news reporting. Minor weaknesses include one low-confidence rating (Garrity's foreign policy, appropriately noted as "no public position found") and some reliance on campaign-website self-reporting for policy detail, which is standard practice. Language is neutral throughout, with no detectable partisan framing or value-laden terminology. The profile successfully documents a competitive swing-state race with strong incumbent advantage reflected in polling and fundraising disparities.
